\documentclass{article}
%% FIX: Manual biblatex users must load inputenc before biblatex to avoid the
%% package warning emitted before lanepaper can participate.
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[
  backend=biber,
  style=authoryear,
  natbib=true,
  sorting=nyt,
  maxcitenames=2,
  maxbibnames=99,
  giveninits=true,
  uniquename=init,
  doi=true,
  url=true,
  isbn=false
]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{references.bib}
%% #48: [nobiblatex] is no longer needed -- the package does not load
%% biblatex at all, so there is nothing to disable. The option is still
%% accepted but warns, and this harness treats warnings as failures.
\usepackage{lanepaper}

\begin{document}

\section{Manual Bibliography Contract}
Manual bibliography loading should work when the style is loaded with
the package no longer loading one.\autocite{butterick2019practical}

\printbibliography

\end{document}
